name: RoadLens - Incident, Accident & Natural Disaster Emergency Dispatch

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "channel": "#traffic-police-crash-dispatch",
  "priority": "{{ $json.emergency_priority }}",
  "event": "ACCIDENT / TEMPO COLLISION",
  "location": "{{ $json.road_name }}",
  "blockage": "{{ $json.blockage_level }}",
  "congestion": "{{ $json.traffic_impact ? $json.traffic_impact.congestion_percentage : 85 }}% (+{{ $json.traffic_impact ? $json.traffic_impact.estimated_delay_minutes : 25 }}m delay)",
  "recommended_detour": "{{ $json.traffic_impact ? $json.traffic_impact.recommended_detour : 'Alternative bypass' }}",
  "dispatch_instructions": [
    "1. Mobilize nearest Highway Patrol Interceptor (ETA < 5 mins)",
    "2. Dispatch 50T hydraulic towing crane to clear overturned chassis",
    "3. Deploy sand / chemical absorbent for diesel spill",
    "4. Push diversion alert to Waze & Google Maps feeds"
  ],
  "work_order_id": "{{ $json.work_order_id }}",
  "timestamp": "{{ $json.processed_at }}"
}

={
  "channel": "#civil-defense-disaster-response",
  "priority": "CATASTROPHIC_TIER_0",
  "event": "NATURAL DISASTER / WATERLOGGING / LANDSLIDE",
  "location": "{{ $json.road_name }}",
  "blockage": "TOTAL CARRIAGEWAY CLOSURE",
  "traffic_impact": "GRIDLOCK 100% (+60m delay)",
  "recommended_detour": "{{ $json.traffic_impact ? $json.traffic_impact.recommended_detour : 'Mandatory evacuation bypass' }}",
  "dispatch_instructions": [
    "1. Immediate closure of road segment between upstream highway interchanges",
    "2. Mobilize Earthmover (JCB) & rock clearing excavators",
    "3. Deploy high-capacity trailer stormwater pumps",
    "4. Issue citizen Red Alert SMS broadcast"
  ],
  "work_order_id": "{{ $json.work_order_id }}",
  "timestamp": "{{ $json.processed_at }}"
}
